name: Sierra Woodworks of Arizona
old_description: Sierra Woodworks of Arizona, LLC specializes in residential architectural woodwork in the Southwest. In addition to our Custom Architectural Millwork, we offer a comprehensive cabinet catalog, cabinet parts, trim and moldings, and flat fine finishing services for doors.
about:
Sierra Woodworks of Arizona, LLC operates from Tucson, Arizona, where it runs a 32,000-square-foot shop equipped with automated production machinery. The company maintains two facilities, both certified under the Architectural Woodwork Institute’s quality program.

The shop focuses on custom commercial cabinetry, casework, and architectural millwork, producing AWI Premium, Custom, and Economy-grade cabinets. Its automated lines allow a capacity exceeding 300 cabinets per day, and the firm also supplies countertops, trim and molding, and flat fine finishing services for doors.

Customers span healthcare and institutional projects, government facilities at federal, state, county, and city levels, hospitality and retirement communities, schools and universities, commercial buildings, charitable organizations, and apartment and condominium developments. Residential work includes custom kitchen and bath cabinetry.

The company emphasizes on-time scheduling and cost consideration as core service principles, leveraging automation to maintain consistent quality across premium and economy product lines.
